reviews.text: Excellent professionals, warm and friendly service
A trusted veterinarian. He treated my late dog with expertise and a very kind and compassionate manner towards both my dog ​​and my family.
Excellent service. The veterinarian treated us with great patience and kindness.

My husband's experience at this vet was terrible. It's clear this man has no empathy for animals, not to mention he's clueless. As soon as he left, he went to another vet, who gave our dog a bad diagnosis, which was later confirmed by another vet.
They didn't attend to us; we brought a little bird and there was nobody there.

We were scammed. They quoted us one price for a certificate over the phone, the first visit was fine, but when we went to pick it up, they charged my 77-year-old mother an extra €150. I don't recommend them.

I had an emergency with my dog ​​Shiro.
Dr. Medina, with a treatment of vitamins and antibiotics, solved the critical situation that we suffered for a few days at home.
Thank you Dr. Medina.
100% recommended

We had an appointment scheduled for Tuesday at 10:00 AM for a hair salon treatment with sedation. Half an hour before the appointment, they called to cancel it. They called again that same day and told us to reschedule for the following Thursday at 10:00 AM. On Thursday, we arrived at 9:45 AM and the salon was closed. We waited until 10:30 AM and no one showed up. We called to find out what the problem was, but no one answered. There was no attempt to resolve the issue. They completely ignored us, even though we had paid for a taxi to and from the appointment.
Good morning and thank you very much, Sergio. We are at your service. Best regards.

With this review, I want to expose your lies in your response to my husband Alfredo, and to reaffirm how good he was to everyone, except you!!!…
In a phone conversation three weeks after he started treatment for mild anemia, you told me he could eat wet food; he didn't want dry food (he ate it until the very last day).
When I asked when we should take him for a checkup, you told me, without any interest in how Theo was doing, that it would be when he was recovered enough to "vaccinate" him (first lie exposed; he was treated until April 19th). You didn't tell us to see him for a follow-up appointment!!!

You can't lie about the diagnosis! I have X-rays that prove he only had gas, which is what you told us! There's no evidence of paralytic ileus! No vomiting, no pain on examination, and he was having normal bowel movements, even that morning! If it had been paralytic ileus, why didn't you admit him? Because he would have required NPO (nothing by mouth) and IV fluids, wouldn't he? The spleen is visible on the X-ray, normal in shape and size, as are the rest of his organs. He only had a small kidney stone. His blood work had improved; transaminase levels were normal, and his anemia had improved. But your mistake was that you didn't listen to us! We explained the cognitive impairment to him; he didn't recognize us, he had trouble walking, and he didn't even show his characteristic discomfort when he did recognize you... Another lie exposed, and it's Theo's fault, who, poor thing, died and exposed you... for your malpractice!

The third lie:
You didn't give him an anti-inflammatory!!! Out of professional obligation, I asked you what you were giving him, and you mentioned an analgesic. I saw the vial and the name of the analgesic!!!! It caused acute tachycardia and respiratory failure… and a fatal outcome!!!! What dose did you give him?

On the 22nd, I spoke with you, and you only mentioned mild anemia and gas… You didn't dare contradict me, but you did say that cats do these things!!! What things???? Die and expose you!!!! That was your explanation. Nothing you say about the diagnosis is true, and you're lucky because you know you can't reveal private information about our pets!!!!
You know what you did!!!! I know too!!! How come my kitten Theo went to heaven and is behind the rainbow forever…

I want to share my sad experience with Dr. Medina. My kitten Theo died on the 19th, after being diagnosed with gas, 5 minutes after arriving home. It was a misdiagnosis, due to not listening to the symptoms of cognitive decline, and the medication administered in the consultation caused him to have tachycardia and respiratory failure, as confirmed by another veterinarian.

Excellent service, both from Dr. Medina and his team.
High level professionals with experience and good knowledge.
I have known them for years and they have always been exemplary in the treatment of my dogs.
100% recommended

Dr. Medina is highly recommended.
Accurate diagnosis.
I'm so sorry for what happened. Please tell me your pet's name and what happened so I can learn more about you and get to know you. Thank you.
Excellent treatment from both the doctor and his assistant
The doctor is such a sweetheart!
They really help the well-being of pets.
